messages:
Evelyn: Postmortem takeaway: cloud auth service had short-lived token-exchange 5xxs that cascaded to model-registry write failures and a small spike in inference errors. Need owners for immediate and longer-term mitigations.
Diego: Noted. I can take immediate client-side changes: add full jitter, cap concurrent refreshes, and per-request retry cap. ETA: PR by Wed.
Hana: I'll do registry-side protective changes: batch metadata flushes, add write circuit-breaker, and implement an automatic read-only fallback for 10m. ETA: next Tue.
Evelyn: Who will own the weekly recurrence check to catch patterns?
Diego: I'll own the first 3 weeks of the weekly pulse and compile a short checklist (deploys, vendor incidents, retry amplification).
Hana: Ops: can you add an alert for registry write success < 97% over 5m and attach the runbook?
Infra-bot: Created ticket: [AUTH-560] "Client jitter + cap" -> Diego (due 2026-04-02). https://jira.redwood/AUTH-560
Infra-bot: Created ticket: [REG-477] "Registry batching + read-only fallback" -> Hana (due 2026-04-06). https://jira.redwood/REG-477
Diego: I'll also add a small CI smoke test to simulate token-exchange failures:
```
# smoke: auth failure spike
python tests/smoke_auth_spike.py --concurrency 150 --duration 30
```
Hana: Runbook snippet for REG-477 I'll add: if writes fail >=3 within 120s -> switch to snapshot-read-only, notify #incidents, and escalate to Evelyn.
Evelyn: Good. Action summary for JIRA post:
- Diego: AUTH-560 PR (jitter + caps) by Wed
- Hana: REG-477 batching + fallback by Tue
- Diego: weekly pulse owner for 3w
- Ops: add 5m alert + runbook link (Infra-bot ticketed)
Infra-bot: Note: AUTH-560 status -> in-progress (updated by Diego)
Diego: I'll post links to PR and smoke test here when ready.
Hana: I'll add perf notes for fallback variance to the runbook.
Evelyn: Thanks. Keep updates in-thread; if we see regression escalate to #incidents and ping me directly.
